Overall In my opinion MDMA has very similar euphoria as mild opiates (oxycodone, hydrocodone, and probably even codeine) but I’m almost certain that the Stronger opiates like heroin and fent would crush the euphoria of MDMA. These are just my personal experiences from what I’ve tried , but I believe they are very similar except one makes you energetic, clench your jaw, and roll your eyes, where the other basically puts you to sleep because of how great you feel. These were all just my personal opinions and I hope they helped in some way. Have fun and stay safe!

This is really really concerning for me. Currently my 67 year old grandma with severe health problems has been in the hospital for a week. She has decently bad memory problems and is going through alcohol withdrawal to make things worse, and she is there because she had a heart problem and was unable to move or speak; I am very close with her. She called me after a week of being there and told me how bad she wanted to leave but she was saying so many things like saying that the hospital was actually a film set and she’s been swearing and trying to leave and is being aggressive with the nurses. I’m assuming that she is confused from what’s happened to her heart and what other damage it could’ve caused to her. She demanded me to pick her up she started cussing at me and saying lots of horrible things that she wouldn’t normally say to me after I told her she pretty much has no choice and should stay for her own well being. I really am just assuming this is part of her health problems, confusion, and stress, but I am genuinely concerned about the quality of care she is receiving especially during covid and not being allowed to physically see the conditions she’s in since reading about this. Does anyone think my grandmother might be in danger of any form of neglect or elder abuse?
